bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai/.worktrees/independent-chat-20261128
test "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD)" = "693aa63b750fa54402c5e321af911778cc096baa" || exit 51
git -C "$p" diff --quiet HEAD -- server/chat server/main.js compose.yaml server/command-module server/adapters || exit 52
test -z "$(git -C "$p" ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- server/chat server/main.js compose.yaml server/command-module server/adapters)" || exit 53
cid="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=debug-ai --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai)"
test -n "$cid" || exit 54
for f in server/chat/index.js server/chat/index.html server/chat/ui.js server/main.js; do
  expected="$(git -C "$p" show HEAD:"$f" | sha256sum | cut -d ' ' -f1)"
  actual="$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum "/app/$f" | cut -d ' ' -f1)"
  test "$expected" = "$actual" || exit 55
done
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}}' "$cid")" = "$p" || exit 56
docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'from runtime.remote_model_gate import validate_completion,MODEL_ID; x=validate_completion(dict(model=MODEL_ID,messages=[dict(role="system",content="s"),dict(role="user",content="u")],max_tokens=32,temperature=0,stream=False,response_format=dict(type="json_object"))); assert x.get("reasoning")=={"effort":"none"}' || exit 57
printf '%s\n' 'WORKTREE_LIVE_PARITY_AND_TEACHER_GATE_SETTING_PASS'
